classification.quote: Hello, One Fullerton! Since landing at Jewel Changi in 2019, we’ve been growing our Shack family across the island—and now, we’re fired up to open our 11th Shack! This new Shack at One Fullerton is serving up more than just burgers—it’s got front-row seats to some of the best views in town. Think Marina Bay Sands, the Singapore Flyer, and that picture-perfect skyline. The space brings a breezy, coastal-inspired feel with subtle nods to Singapore’s vibrant culture. But what are we really excited about? Our exclusive Concrete collab with a true local gem—Mrs Kueh. About the artwork in our Shack Say hello to the wild side of the Shack. Local artist Sadiq Mansor splashes his signature style across our walls with an artwork inspired by creatures native to Singapore—reimagined with a magical twist for our Mythical Tide theme. From the shy pangolin to the rare pink dolphin and the majestic sambar deer, Sadiq brings these animals to life like you’ve never seen before. Think coral-crowned otters, tidal-winged hornbills, and glowing, deep-sea crabs—all vibing in a dreamy world where land meets sea and myth meets reality. Known for his bold characters and playful storytelling, Sadiq turns the everyday into the extraordinary. His mural is a celebration of Singapore’s rich biodiversity, brought to life with color, curiosity, and a whole lot of Shack spirit. One Pineapple Please We’ve teamed up with Mrs Kueh to create a Shack-exclusive dessert that blends our vanilla frozen custard with her signature Pineapple and Citrus tart—a buttery, golden classic with sweet, tangy pineapple jam. It’s rich, refreshing, and a perfect bite of nostalgia in every spoonful. It’s our way of giving a little nod to heritage flavours while mixing things up in a fun, new way. As part of our Stand For Something Good mission, we love teaming up with local partners who put heart into what they do—just like Mrs Kueh. They’re known for their handmade, traditional kuehs, and together we’ve created a Concrete that’s a little unexpected yet a little nostalgic. It’s our way of celebrating the local community we’re proud to be part of. See you soon at the Shack!

classification.quote: Introducing Aloha Shack Introducing: Aloha Shack Menu Say E komo mai (welcome) to the Aloha Shack Menu! We’re teaming up with Butcher’s Block and in collaboration with Raffles Hotel Singapore. It’s more than just a menu, it’s an experience that discovers the Hawaiian and local favorite’s flavors. Meet Chef Jordan Inspired by Chef Jordan Keao’s roots in Hawaii and his journey in Singapore over the past decade, this menu brings together woodfire cooking, Hawaiian flavors and the rich cultural heritage found right in Raffles Hotel Singapore. It’s a celebration of authenticity, history and genuine hospitality. At its core, the Aloha Shack Menu reflects a shared philosophy between Chef Jordan and Shake Shack: to honour real, whole ingredients, celebrate culture and create food that feels both elevated and approachable. BBQ Smokehouse Shack A made-to-order quarter-pound per patty of 100% Angus beef topped with smoky minced beef gravy, BBQ kecap manis, pickled jalapeño and pickled red onions on a toasted potato bun. Available as a single or double. Huli Huli Chicken Hand-breaded crispy chicken breast or thigh glazed in Huli Huli sauce, topped with coleslaw and lettuce served on a toasted potato bun. Salted Egg Fries Crispy crinkle-cut fries topped with salted egg yolk sauce, garlic butter, white pepper and fried curry leaves Roselle Ginger Lemonade Roselle ginger concentrate mixed with our house-made lemonade Ube Coconut Crème Ube coconut hand-spun with vanilla frozen custard, topped with mochi coated in Kinako powder.

classification.quote: We’ll be right back! A New and Improved Happy Point App is Coming Soon! Exciting news, Shack fans! We’re rolling out a brand-new and improved interface for the Happy Point app, designed to make your experience even better. Get ready for a smoother, more rewarding journey as we enhance how you earn and redeem points at Shake Shack! Temporary Downtime – What You Need to Know As we gear up for the big transition, there will be a temporary downtime starting 8th March, with the app making its grand return on 14th April. During this period, here’s what you need to take note of: Redeem Your Vouchers Before the Closure: Be sure to use your existing vouchers before the app goes offline on 8th March. Voucher Issuance Paused: No new vouchers will be issued via Happy Point from 8th March onwards. Keep Earning Points: You can still earn points at Shake Shack by scanning the QR code at checkout. However, point redemption will be temporarily paused and will resume once the app is back. Stay Updated Don’t miss any important updates, follow us on Instagram @shakeshacksg for the latest news! Your Data is Safe and Secure We want to assure you that your account data will remain safe and secure throughout this transition. We appreciate your patience and can’t wait to introduce a fresh, improved Happy Point experience! Got questions? Feel free to reach out to us—we’re happy to help. See you soon with a brand-new Happy Point app!
